column1: # What an optimization agent may not touch (protected, always restored), what it may
# touch but caps a KEEP at INVESTIGATE (tuning), and added source lines that hint the
# change affects measuring rather than the application (sensitive, regular expressions).
# Format: kind<TAB>pattern. Paths are relative to the target root; `*` crosses folders.
# Engine profiles (e.g. unity) add their own lines after these; `-kind<TAB>pattern` there
# or in a project's file removes one of these.
